name: Fastest Headless WordPress API – 10x Faster than WPGraphQL & REST
author: andyryan

sections.description:
Stop paying the “Headless Tax.”

Most headless WordPress sites are slower than they should be because traditional REST API or WPGraphQL solutions calculate data on-the-fly. Every request triggers heavy PHP logic, multiple database queries, and complex schema execution that adds hundreds of milliseconds to your TTFB (Time To First Byte).

Headless Bridge uses a “Zero-Runtime” architecture.

By pre-calculating and pre-compiling your content into optimized, flat JSON the moment you hit SAVE, we eliminate the request-time bottleneck. Your frontend gets the data it needs via a single, fast REST endpoint without the server-side heavy lifting.

🚀 Performance Benchmarks

  • Traditional WPGraphQL: ~500ms TTFB | 12+ DB Queries
  • Traditional REST API: ~800ms TTFB | Heavy PHP overhead
  • Headless Bridge: ~50ms TTFB (10x Faster) | 1 DB Query

Core Features (100% Free)

  • ✅ Pre-compiled JSON – Zero runtime overhead by serving data from a custom, optimized database table.
  • ✅ Flat JSON structure – Intuitive for React/Next.js developers; no more deeply nested “nodes”.
  • ✅ SEO Ready – Automatically includes Yoast or RankMath metadata in the response.
  • ✅ Image Optimization – Includes srcset data specifically for next/image components.
  • ✅ Multi-language Support – Works out-of-the-box with WPML and Polylang.
  • ✅ Secure by Design – Features UUID-based IDs, rate limiting, and API key authentication.

Standard/Professional Features (Separate Addon)

Upgrade to the Standard/Agency addon for advanced architectural needs:
* 🚀 ACF Integration – Automatically include Advanced Custom Fields in your pre-compiled responses.
* 🚀 Webhooks – Trigger external services like Vercel or Netlify on content updates.
* 🚀 Priority Support – Direct email access to our engineering team.

Standard/Agency users: Priority email support included with your license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/headless-bridge, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Go to Headless Bridge → Dashboard to verify installation.
  4. Click “Recompile All Content” to process existing posts.
  5. Use the API endpoints in your frontend application.
sections.faq:
Does this replace WPGraphQL?

Yes, for most use cases. If you need complex nested queries, WPGraphQL might be better, but Headless Bridge is significantly faster for standard content delivery.

How does it handle content updates?

Content is automatically recompiled in the background when you save a post. There’s no manual cache invalidation needed.

Does it work with ACF (Advanced Custom Fields)?

Yes! ACF support is available in the Pro addon plugin (sold separately).

What about custom post types?

Yes! Enable them in Settings → Enabled Post Types.

How do I preview draft content?

Generate an API key in Headless Bridge → API Keys, then use it in your requests with the preview=true parameter.
